purpose: Test whether the scale-free multipole-gated 3D tensor activation transfers to every registered galaxy and cluster baryonic map under mass uncertainties before any lensing outcome is opened.

candidate.sigma: P0667 multipole gate times P0666 physical-length local 3D activation
candidate.surface_to_volume: sech-squared with component scale height equal to its projected RMS radius
candidate.map_resolution: each component is conservatively anti-aliased to the common 33-cell cubic grid before lifting

selection_rule: The sole P0667 formula advances to a spent RX J2129 3D map build only if every registered coverage, mass, scale-height, ellipticity, domain-separation, sensitivity, parameter, and blindness gate passes.
claim_boundary: P0668 tests coefficient transfer and does not solve the nonlinear tensor field or compare a target outcome.
RMS-radius sech-squared deprojection is deterministic but not a substitute for a native three-dimensional baryonic likelihood.
A pass authorizes one spent-cluster map build, not an untouched holdout opening.
No spent RX J2129 image and no P0633/P0640 target may be used in P0668 development or selection.
